story.title: The Great Turnip Tricycle Debacle
story.question: How did Silas manage to ruin the farmers' market while trying to save it?
story.answer: He unveiled an automated vegetable chopper that launched root vegetables into the crowd.

story_beats.headline: The Grand Unveiling
story_beats.speech: Behold citizens of Oakhaven! My patented root vegetable separator will revolutionize how you harvest your turnips forevermore!
story_beats.label: The Invention
story_beats.visual_prompt: An inventor named Silas in a crowded medieval farmers market gesturing proudly toward a strange mechanical contraption with spinning blades and brass funnels, while market vendors watch with skeptical expressions, day lighting, medium shot.

story_beats.headline: The Calibration Crisis
story_beats.speech: Just a minor adjustment to the tension springs should stop the machine from shaking quite so violently on the cobblestones.
story_beats.label: The Adjustment
story_beats.visual_prompt: Silas frantically turns a large brass dial on the side of his mechanical contraption, sparks flying slightly, surrounded by crates of purple turnips in the busy market square, close up shot.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Catastrophe
story_beats.speech: Oh dear me, the hopper intake has reversed itself and now it is aggressively chewing through the mayor's prize pumpkins!
story_beats.label: The Malfunction
story_beats.visual_prompt: The mechanical contraption vibrates wildly, shooting a stream of sliced turnips and pumpkin chunks high into the air above the market stalls, causing panicked shoppers to duck, wide shot.

story_beats.headline: Market Mayhem
story_beats.speech: Well at least the slaw is evenly distributed across every single merchant tent from here to the clock tower!
story_beats.label: The Aftermath
story_beats.visual_prompt: Silas sits defeated in a wagon filled with scattered turnips, covered in vegetable pulp, while annoyed villagers wipe turnip bits off their clothes in the messy market square, medium wide shot.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful animated comedy style with exaggerated character expressions and vibrant market stalls.

characters.Silas: An eccentric inventor with unruly red hair, wearing a patched brown vest, goggles pushed up onto his forehead, and soot-stained trousers.

locations.Oakhaven Market: A bustling medieval town square filled with striped canvas awnings, wooden crates of colorful vegetables, and cobblestone streets.

objects.Contraption: A towering, chaotic assembly of copper pipes, spinning steel blades, wooden gears, and a large metal funnel at the top.

story.title: The Great Salt-Tide Regatta
story.question: Can a wooden wind-car win the seaside race?
story.answer: Yes, by utilizing the coastal updrafts instead of sails.

story_beats.headline: The Driftwood Hull
story_beats.speech: We cannot use standard cloth sails because the harbor crosswinds will snap our mainmast in two instantly.
story_beats.label: Hull Construction
story_beats.visual_prompt: A close-up of a young female builder with grease-smudged cheeks examining a carved wooden hull inside a cluttered seaside workshop filled with ropes and tools.

story_beats.headline: The Rotor Mechanism
story_beats.speech: Instead of catching the wind directly, this spinning wooden drum will convert the gusts into forward wheel torque.
story_beats.label: Rotor Assembly
story_beats.visual_prompt: The builder and an elderly mechanic attaching a large vertical wooden rotor to the chassis of a three-wheeled land yacht on the sunny pebble beach.

story_beats.headline: The Sudden Squall
story_beats.speech: The fierce coastal gale is hitting us sideways now, but the angled rotor blades are spinning faster than ever.
story_beats.label: Squall Test
story_beats.visual_prompt: The land yacht speeding along the wet shore past a line of wind-bent pine trees while the builder struggles to adjust the steering lever against the gale.

story_beats.headline: The Victory Dash
story_beats.speech: We crossed the finish line ahead of the fleet by turning the storm's fury into pure forward momentum.
story_beats.label: Finish Line
story_beats.visual_prompt: The builder raising her arms in triumph as her innovative wind-car rolls past a painted wooden archway while cheering festival crowds wave banners.

visual_bible.style: Bright, textured stop-motion aesthetic with rich wood grains and vibrant coastal colors.

characters.builder: A young inventive woman with bright hazel eyes, wearing a canvas work apron over a woolen blue sweater.
characters.mechanic: An elderly man with a silver beard, wearing a weathered leather cap and a grease-stained canvas vest.

locations.workshop: A rustic wooden shack beside the harbor, cluttered with nautical ropes, carved pulleys, and spare timber.
locations.beach: A wide, windy pebble beach stretching beside deep blue ocean waves under a partly cloudy sky.

objects.chassis: A sturdy three-wheeled frame constructed from weathered oak planks and fitted with iron-rimmed wooden wheels.
objects.rotor: A tall vertical assembly of curved wooden blades designed to rotate on a central brass axis.

story.title: The Great Salt-Tide Regatta of Saltmarsh
story.question: How do you win a race against the incoming tide using only wind-up crabs?
story.answer: By building a spring-loaded catamaran that uses the receding surf as a mechanical launchpad.

story_beats.headline: The Midnight Discovery
story_beats.speech: Look at these old mechanical blueprints! The tide chart proves we can use the undertow to launch.
story_beats.label: The Blueprint Reveal
story_beats.visual_prompt: A young inventor holding a glowing lantern inspects a weathered parchment on a wooden dock at night, surrounded by brass gears.

story_beats.headline: Constructing the Hull
story_beats.speech: We must weld these copper floats tightly so the heavy brass clockwork does not sink into the mud.
story_beats.label: Welding the Catamaran
story_beats.visual_prompt: An inventor uses a sputtering blue torch to weld copper pontoons together in a cluttered workshop filled with marine salvage.

story_beats.headline: The Spring-Loaded Release
story_beats.speech: Wind the main tension spring until it clicks three times. When the wave hits, release the trigger!
story_beats.label: Trigger Mechanism
story_beats.visual_prompt: An inventor wearing leather goggles pulls a thick lever to lock a massive steel spring into place aboard a miniature vessel.

story_beats.headline: Crossing the Finish Line
story_beats.speech: The wave is lifting us over the reef! We crossed the finish line first while everyone else stuck in the sand.
story_beats.label: Triumphant Payoff
story_beats.visual_prompt: A small copper catamaran bursts over a cresting white wave toward a crowded wooden pier decorated with colorful festive banners.

visual_bible.style: Whimsical steampunk illustration with vibrant coastal colors and detailed mechanical textures.

characters.inventor: A young person with messy brown hair, wearing a soot-stained leather apron and brass goggles pushed up on their forehead.

locations.workshop: A cluttered seaside shack overflowing with spare gears, blueprints, and hanging fishing nets.
locations.dock: A weathered wooden pier extending over turquoise ocean waters during a sunny afternoon festival.

objects.catamaran: A twin-hulled vessel made of polished copper and brass, driven by a heavy internal clockwork spring.
objects.lantern: An antique brass hurricane lamp casting a warm amber glow.
